## From one random variable to two {.bvn-slide}

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(plotly)

# Correlations the joint density steps through, one per click once it's up
bvn_rhos <- c(0, 0.5, 0.9, -0.5, -0.9)

lim <- 4
g <- seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 101)
n <- length(g)
phi <- dnorm(g)
wall <- lim - 0.02   # just in front of the axis walls, so the curves don't z-fight them

# Shaded area under a marginal, as a flat strip of triangles between the floor
# (vertices 1..n) and the curve (vertices n+1..2n)
strip <- list(i = c(0:(n - 2), 1:(n - 1)),
              j = c(1:(n - 1), (n + 1):(2 * n - 1)),
              k = c(n:(2 * n - 2), n:(2 * n - 2)))
n_tri <- length(strip$i)
flat <- list(ambient = 1, diffuse = 0, specular = 0, fresnel = 0)

bvn_axis <- function(title, range, ticks, ...) {
  list(title = list(text = title), range = range, tickvals = ticks,
       gridcolor = "#d9d9d9", zeroline = FALSE, showspikes = FALSE,
       showbackground = TRUE, backgroundcolor = "#EFEFEF",
       tickfont = list(size = 12), tickangle = 0, ...)
}

bvn_label <- function(x, y, text, colour, visible = TRUE) {
  list(x = x, y = y, z = 0.3, text = text, showarrow = FALSE, xanchor = "left",
       font = list(size = 16, color = colour), visible = visible)
}

# Trace order matters: bivariate_normal.js addresses traces by index
p_bvn <- plot_ly(width = 1000, height = 560) |>
  add_surface(x = g, y = g, z = matrix(0, n, n), visible = FALSE,
              cmin = 0, cmax = 0.37, showscale = FALSE, hoverinfo = "skip",
              colorscale = list(c(0, "#f7eded"), c(0.4, "#e0676c"), c(1, "#9b0000")),
              lighting = list(ambient = 0.85, diffuse = 0.35, specular = 0.05,
                              roughness = 0.9, fresnel = 0.05),
              contours = list(x = list(highlight = FALSE), y = list(highlight = FALSE),
                              z = list(show = TRUE, start = 0.02, end = 0.4, size = 0.04,
                                       color = "#ffffff", width = 1, highlight = FALSE))) |>
  # X's marginal on the back wall
  add_trace(type = "mesh3d", x = c(g, g), y = rep(wall, 2 * n), z = c(rep(0, n), phi),
            i = strip$i, j = strip$j, k = strip$k, facecolor = rep("#c5050c", n_tri), opacity = 0.15,
            flatshading = TRUE, lighting = flat, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
  add_trace(type = "scatter3d", mode = "lines", x = g, y = rep(wall, n), z = phi,
            line = list(color = "#c5050c", width = 7), hoverinfo = "skip") |>
  # Y's marginal on the side wall, grown by the animation
  add_trace(type = "mesh3d", x = rep(-wall, 2 * n), y = c(g, g), z = rep(0, 2 * n),
            i = strip$i, j = strip$j, k = strip$k, facecolor = rep("#0479a8", n_tri), opacity = 0.15,
            flatshading = TRUE, lighting = flat, hoverinfo = "skip", visible = FALSE) |>
  add_trace(type = "scatter3d", mode = "lines", x = rep(-wall, n), y = g, z = rep(0, n),
            line = list(color = "#0479a8", width = 7), hoverinfo = "skip", visible = FALSE) |>
  layout(
    showlegend = FALSE,
    paper_bgcolor = "#F7F7F7",
    margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0),
    font = list(family = "Red Hat Text, sans-serif", color = "#333333"),
    scene = list(
      xaxis = bvn_axis("x", c(-lim, lim), seq(-lim, lim, 2)),
      yaxis = bvn_axis("", c(-lim, lim), seq(-lim, lim, 2), showticklabels = FALSE),
      zaxis = bvn_axis("", c(0, 0.42), seq(0.1, 0.4, 0.1)),
      aspectmode = "manual", aspectratio = list(x = 1, y = 1, z = 0.7),
      camera = list(projection = list(type = "orthographic")),   # set by the animation
      dragmode = "turntable", hovermode = FALSE,
      annotations = list(
        bvn_label(1.2, wall, "f<sub>X</sub>(x)", "#c5050c"),
        bvn_label(-wall, 1.2, "f<sub>Y</sub>(y)", "#0479a8", visible = FALSE)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE, doubleClick = FALSE)

p_bvn <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_bvn,
  paste(readLines("bvn-anim/bivariate_normal.js"), collapse = "\n"),
  data = list(grid = g, rhos = bvn_rhos)
)

# One empty fragment per animation step after the first
htmltools::tagList(
  p_bvn,
  lapply(seq_len(1 + length(bvn_rhos)), function(i) htmltools::span(class = "fragment bvn-step"))
)
```

## Slicing the bivariate normal {.app-slide}

::: {.app-frame data-app="bivariate_normal_app.html" data-title="Slicing a bivariate normal"}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// The widget is a separate page framed here. The <iframe> is built at runtime
// because `embed-resources: true` would otherwise inline the target into a
// data: URI, breaking the app's relative asset paths and its service worker.
// Mounting only once the slide is reached also delays the webR download.
(function () {
  function mount() {
    document.querySelectorAll("section.present .app-frame[data-app]").forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.dataset.mounted) return;
      el.dataset.mounted = "1";
      var f = document.createElement("iframe");
      f.src = el.dataset.app;
      f.title = el.dataset.title || "Interactive widget";
      f.setAttribute("allow", "clipboard-write");
      el.appendChild(f);
    });
  }
  // Reveal is not defined while this script is parsed, so wire up after load.
  window.addEventListener("load", function () {
    if (window.Reveal && typeof Reveal.on === "function") Reveal.on("slidechanged", mount);
    mount();
  });
})();
</script>
```
